about.intro: I'm **Sneh Raunak** — building where *AI / ML*, **explainability**, and **software engineering** meet.
about.description: I work across the complete path: **data → models → APIs → software → users**. The goal is not just a model; it is a system people can understand and use.
about.full:
Hi, I'm **Sneh Raunak**, a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at Chandigarh University (2023–2027), with a CGPA of **8.68**.

My focus is AI / ML × Software Engineering: building complete systems that connect data, models, APIs, and interfaces. I care particularly about explainable AI, where a system can make its reasoning more legible rather than asking people to trust a black box.

My selected work includes *SentinelFlow*, a synthetic-data fraud-risk reference system, a Student Performance Predictor Pro, and Anony Talk. I work with *Python*, *FastAPI*, *React*, *Next.js*, *TypeScript*, and *PostgreSQL* to take ideas from technical foundation to usable product.

Every project is an opportunity to make complexity clearer, build with purpose, and improve the engineering behind the experience.

projects.title: SentinelFlow
projects.description: SentinelFlow is a synthetic-data fraud-risk reference system that brings together risk workflows, explainability, and a polished operational interface. It is designed as a transparent engineering demonstration rather than a claim about live financial decisions.

projects.title: Student Performance Predictor Pro
projects.description: A full-stack student performance application with authenticated workflows, prediction and uncertainty endpoints, and actionable recommendations. The experience pairs a FastAPI backend with a focused React and TypeScript interface.

projects.title: Anony Talk
projects.description: An anonymous reflection and community web application built around safe, lightweight conversations. It is a product experience, not a substitute for professional healthcare or crisis support.

research.title: Explainable Machine Learning for Predicting Problematic Short-Form Video Use Among University Students
research.summary: An explainable machine-learning research project focused on turning model comparison and feature analysis into reasoning that can be inspected, challenged, and understood.

Developed frontend fundamentals and version-control habits while creating responsive interfaces and personal projects.

Building ML systems and full-stack projects that connect transparent data workflows with polished product experiences.
Completing my B.Tech and continuing to deepen my work in machine learning systems, backend engineering, and thoughtful software products.
